title: ERAVOS domain (tools/<domain>/domain.json)
description: Everything a domain is lives in its folder. The shell reads only this manifest, the units/modes/needs it registers, and its packs.

core.description: core/ files in load order (engines, theory, shared UI kit) — shared by the domain's tools, never inside a tool

ports.description: port types it speaks: audio, modulation, event, asset, image, video, text, json, style, layout, trigger, number

content.description: content/<kind>/ — domain-wide data packs (genres, lessons, songs)
